title: 2023 Panini Select #FUT-JGI Jahmyr Gibbs Detroit Lions Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select Jahmyr Gibbs Rookie Future RC #FUT-JGI card is a must-have for any Detroit Lions fan. Featuring the National Football League (NFL) player in his rookie year, this sports trading card is an insert with a short print and parallel/variety feature. The card is part of the 2023 Panini Select set and was manufactured by Panini in 2024. 

The card is in English and has the card number FUT-JGI. It falls under the category of Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Trading Card Singles. This trading card is perfect for any collector or fan who wants to add a piece of football history to their collection.
